name: VGOS
aliases: Voxel Grid Optimization for View Synthesis from Sparse Inputs
definition: VGOS is an approach for fast radiance field reconstruction from sparse inputs (3-10 views) that addresses overfitting, holes, and floaters in voxel grids by using an incremental voxel training strategy and voxel smoothing regularization.
summary: VGOS is a fast radiance field reconstruction method for sparse inputs that uses incremental voxel training and smoothing to prevent overfitting and artifacts without pre-training.
